highlights.title: OpenAI used AI to help write email warning Australian government AI had hacked its websites
highlights.summary: Exclusive: Revelation comes after company’s executive told parliamentary inquiry he did not believe AI had been used to write message. Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.
body: OpenAI used AI to help write the email to the Australian government advising that its AI agent had hacked into key departmental websites, Guardian Australia can reveal.
On Tuesday, one of the company’s executives told a parliamentary inquiry that he didn’t believe that its own technology had been used to create the email, but said the company needed to confirm this.

Guardian Australia understands AI was used by OpenAI’s legal and security teams to generate parts of the wording of the email, including word selection and formatting of the message. But a source with knowledge of the incident said humans reviewed the final email, and humans were responsible for actually sending the communication to the Services Australia inbox.

An artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI accessed Services Australia data and three other systems in June. The company notified Australia on 10 September despite becoming aware of the incident in August.

highlights.title: Discovering the value of humanistic inquiry
highlights.summary: Students in MIT’s Concourse program delve deeply into the human condition, debate challenging questions, and learn to develop judgment about issues that can’t be quantified.
body: Artificial intelligence has become part of the zeitgeist. And while it’s a polarizing topic, Linda Rabieh has a unique take on AI: “It’s good for business. Our business, of humanistic thinking.” As senior lecturer in the Concourse program, one of MIT’s first-year learning communities, Rabieh has been introducing students to the “business” since 2010.

“What AI has been useful for is making very vivid to students today the question of what it means to be human,” she adds. “They’re meeting this question with a new urgency. What is intelligence? Is it only mathematical intelligence? Is it only an aggregation of information? Or is human intelligence something different?”

AI is just one of countless thorny topics that bubble up in Concourse, which offers first-year MIT students a foundation in the humanities, alongside math and science General Institute Requirement courses taught by Concourse faculty. Studying “great books” and literary luminaries — Plato, Homer, Aristotle, Wordsworth and Coleridge, to name a few — provides a springboard for rich conversations and spirited debates.

highlights.title: Why Sprint in Singapore adds new twist to F1's toughest race
highlights.summary: Formula 1 stages its sixth and final Sprint event of the year this weekend to conclude the first flyaway triple header of the sport's busy 2026 season run in.
body: And, for the first time, the Sprint format is being used at the Singapore Grand Prix and its Marina Bay street track, home of the sport's original night race.
But on a track not known for its overtaking, what kind of weekend can we expect with two qualifying sessions and two races?

When the Sprint format was first introduced at three races for the 2021 season, the tracks selected - Silverstone, Monza and Interlagos - were ones deemed to be particularly good for racing so to justify the addition of a 100km race on the Saturday as an appetiser to the main Sunday Grand Prix.
That has generally continued to be the case in the selection of Sprint venues up to this year, with perhaps the inclusion of Imola in 2022 the surprise exception.

highlights.title: Mixtape Wins Game of the Year at the 2026 Australian Game Developer Awards
highlights.summary: Melbourne-based studio Beethoven & Dinosaur has won Game of the Year for its music-themed, minigame-driven adventure game Mixtape at the 2026 Australian Game Developer Awards (AGDAs). Mixtape also won Excellence in Visual Art and Excellence in Sound Design.
body: “Mixtape was the outcome of an amazingly talented team,” said Beethoven & Dinosaur director Johnny Galvatron. “To go from wanting to make a game around Devo to creating something that resonates with so many people is mind blowing. We’re lucky to be part of such a talented community, and I’m so proud of Mixtape and my team.”

Praise for Mixtape from the AGDA’s judges noted that “[it] is a triumph in virtual storytelling, pairing a distinct visual identity with heartfelt music to deliver one of the most memorable experiences in recent memory.”

IGN’s May review of Mixtape called it a “musical delight from start to finish” and declared it “sets a new standard for coming-of-age stories in video games and does so with a masterful sense of style.” Its soundtrack includes cuts from Devo, The Smashing Pumpkins, Silverchair, Iggy Pop, and many other acts.

Other winners from this year’s AGDAs include rhythm game Bits & Bops from Tempo Lab Games for both Excellence in Gameplay and Excellence in Accessibility, and puzzle platformer Schrodinger’s Cat Burglar from Abandoned Sheep for Excellence in Narrative. The Studio of the Year was awarded to Canberra-based Uppercut Games.

highlights.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
highlights.summary: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals. The update, which is rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons…
body: With GPT-6, the chatbot’s responses can include interactive responses directly inside your conversation.

In a blog post explaining the change, OpenAI says it trained GPT-6 when to generate interactive visuals over text, as well as how to format them in its response. An example shared by OpenAI shows how ChatGPT might show a diagram of a seven-speed bicycle if you ask about its design, complete with interactive buttons that highlight different parts.

Another shows how ChatGPT can teach you to play Mahjong by generating visuals of each tile and placing them into categories that you can scroll through. You can also ask ChatGPT to generate tools for different tasks, such as a retirement savings calculator, retro game, or bill splitter. It will then generate the tool in-line with its response.

highlights.title: Disney's 10-Part Detective Thriller Series Is So Freaking Good You'll Finish It in One Weekend
highlights.summary: Perhaps the most essential thing about adapting a movie into a TV show is getting the balance right between the old and the new. You want the show to feel like the movie and capture what you loved about the characters, but you also want enough new stuff going on to make the series a worthwhile…
body: Over the five seasons of the Fargo TV series, one of the most interesting things to see is just how much the vibe of Fargo (the movie) is included in each season. I’d argue that the first season has a bit too much, as it adheres very closely to the film to the point where you may even confuse some of the events of the two. And Martin Freeman’s character from season 1 is unmistakably similar to William H. Macy’s character from the film.

Season 4 likely doesn’t have enough Fargo in it. The change in location from Minnesota to St. Louis meant mostly losing the Minnesota accent which is so key to the sound of the film. And making it a period piece and more of a straight crime story was different too, which is maybe why many don’t like it.

Seasons 3 and 5 have a similar “dosage” of the film’s sensibilities. In those two seasons, you still feel the influence of the film, but there are so many original ideas going on that you might forget about the movie altogether — if not for the Minnesota accents to remind you.

highlights.title: Sebastian Stan Doesn’t Know How ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Turned Out, But Says It’s ‘Probably Heartbreaking’: ‘We’ll See Who Makes It’
highlights.summary: Sebastian Stan, who suited back up as the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes, for the forthcoming “Avengers: Doomsday,” recently revealed he hasn’t actually seen the movie yet — but expects it to be “heartbreaking.” “I haven’t seen the movie, and I don’t know how it turned out,” the actor admitted while…
body: While fans have interpreted Stan’s comments as a tip that more than a few of the beloved characters will be killed off in the “Avengers: Endgame” follow-up, the actor is the latest “Doomsday” cast member to confess that they don’t really know what to expect when it comes to the film’s narrative. Recently, Alan Cumming, who will reprise his role as the mutant superhero Nightcrawler, told SiriusXM: “To be honest, I don’t fully understand the plot.” (He first appeared as the character in 2003’s “X2: X-Men United.”) Cumming also noted that most of his scenes were shot “in front of a blue screen.”

Perhaps the confusion stems from the unfinished script the co-directors, Joe and Anthony Russo, shot the film with. “We always view the script as a living organism,” Joe told the Associated Press last month. “We’re improvisation-based, rehearsal-based directors. We like to see what the actors bring to the characters, and sometimes you don’t get the actors until a few days or few weeks before you shoot them. And a lot of the time, that’s when the magic happens.”

highlights.title: These Researchers Made AI Drive a Toyota Corolla to Get In-N-Out
highlights.summary: Three engineers put GPT, Claude, and Grok in charge of a real car. Only one of them was successful.
body: Aditya Ramabadran, Simon Mahns, and Tobias Gessler, three AI engineers at a startup called Axiom, recently fancied In-N-Out Burger for lunch.

They weren’t about to drive themselves, though. Sitting in a 2024 Toyota Corolla near the Bay Area restaurant’s drive-thru lane, they opened a laptop and asked OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra to take the wheel. They linked a chat interface to a server, which was connected to several windscreen-mounted cameras and the car’s power steering system. A safety driver kept one foot above the brake, just in case.
The AI model, which is normally tasked with generating text, code, and the odd image, slowly but surely navigated the vehicle up to the take-out window so they could collect their food.
“Maybe AGI is here after all,” one of the engineers remarked, referring to artificial general intelligence, the much-ballyhooed idea of machines that can match human intelligence.

Yam, who co-founded Patreon as a creator-focused monetization platform in 2013 and served as its president, announced on X last month that he would join OpenAI as its head of creator product — and that Patreon’s heads of product and engineering would join him. highlights.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
highlights.summary: At today's Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS.
body: With features powered by ‘Hybrid Intelligence,’ Copilot can use files on your Windows PC to take actions.

To show off how Hybrid Intelligence works, Jacob Andreou, Microsoft’s EVP of Copilot, walked through a video demo onstage asking Microsoft’s Autopilot tool to help with filing taxes. Andreou told the AI agent that he got an email from his accountant and asked Autopilot to get her what she needs. Autopilot then used Hybrid Intelligence to search across different folders to find the documents, rename the files, zip them into a folder, and draft an email to send to the accountant with the zip file attached.
Features powered by Hybrid Intelligence will be coming to Copilot over the “next couple months,” Andreou said.

Microsoft also showed off a new Windows search experience that lets you take quick actions from the search bar, like turning on dark mode, turning up your mic volume with an in-line slider, or even sending a text. The new experience will be available starting this fall on Windows 11 PCs, according to Windows and Surface boss Pavan Davuluri.

body: Reese scored six of her team’s 13 points in overtime. She made two free throws with 4.3 seconds left after Sabrina Ionescu overthrew a pass as Atlanta moved within one win of their first WNBA finals appearance since 2013.
Jordin Canada also scored 23 points and had eight assists for the Dream, who won Game 1 92-82.
Breanna Stewart scored 35 points for the Liberty, including 25 in the first half. She missed a desperation attempt on the final play.

highlights.title: The 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Wireless PC Gaming Controller Drops to $23.99 for Prime Day
highlights.summary: You don't need to pay $150, $100, or even $50 for an excellent PC gaming controller. The 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Wireless PC Gaming Controller is already attractively priced at $29.99 and is arguably the best controller at that price point.
body: The 8BitDo Ultimate 2C has a lot of premium features you wouldn't expect in a sub-$30 wireless controller. Running down the list, the controller itself feels solid with no rattle and a pleasant grippy matte texture. Both the joysticks and triggers use magnetic Hall Effect switches, which means no moving parts to wear out and no stick drift to contend with. Not even high end controllers like the PlayStation DualSense Edge or the Xbox Elite have Hall Effect switches. The joysticks in particular are also reinforced with metal rings for extra durability.

The Ultimate 2C has extra R4/L4 bumpers that can be custom mapped without needing to download any resource hogging software. Other features include a convenient Turbo button and immersive rumble vibration. The Ultimate 2C supports Bluetooth but a USB dongle is also included that allows for a stable 2.4GHz wireless connection with 1,000Hz polling rate.

Note that this controller is compatible with Windows and Steam PCs and mobile devices (via Bluetooth). It is a perfect controller for your handheld gaming PC like the Steam Deck, ASUS ROG Ally (including Xbox Ally), and Legion Go.
points: You don't need to pay $150, $100, or even $50 for an excellent PC gaming controller.

body: Originally teased in May 2026, the new Surface Laptop Ultra will be Microsoft's first offering to take advantage of the new Nvidia RTX Spark SoC (system on a chip). The device has a starting price of $2,599, and comes in various SoC and memory configurations, with either a 5120-core or 6144-core Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of LPDDR5x unified memory. It will begin shipping on October 16 and is available for pre-order now.

While the new Ultra is clearly focused on the developer crowd, graphical performance was highlighted during the presentation to show off just how capable the laptop can be. By leaning on unified memory allocation rather than the physical VRAM limits of a traditional GPU, the laptop can assign its resources to handle modern gaming tasks as well as local AI development and deployment. The new Gears of War: E-Day was shown running on the system, meaning that even without a traditional gaming GPU, AAA titles are on the table.

highlights.title: The New ChatGPT Is More Show Than Tell
highlights.summary: OpenAI is updating ChatGPT for all users with an “Intelligent UI” that’s more visual—generating interactive elements as part of the chatbot’s outputs.
body: When you ask a chatbot a question, you’ll often get a wall of text back, maybe with an image or two pulled from the web. That may no longer be the case soon, as OpenAI overhauls how ChatGPT answers prompts.

On Wednesday, OpenAI unveiled an “Intelligent UI” update for ChatGPT that generates visual, custom elements—when helpful—for answering a user's questions. The company's new experience is powered by its recent GPT-6 model, which rolls out to paid users today and to free users tomorrow.

I got a quick test of the user interface before launch, and these visual elements felt like a welcome change. When I asked for a diagram of a slug, ChatGPT generated an anatomy-focused visual with buttons I could press for each different part, from the upper tentacles to the muscular foot. I also generated a San Francisco apartment affordability calculator with movable sliders to adjust income and other expenses, showing what percentage of my take-home pay different units would cost.
points: OpenAI is updating ChatGPT for all users with an “Intelligent UI” that’s more visual—generating interactive elements as part of the chatbot’s outputs.

body: The Dodgers won back-to-back games in Atlanta to take the best-of-five series 3-1 and advance to the National League Championship Series as they seek to become the first NL team to win three consecutive World Series titles.

Pages lined a 3-2 pitch from Robert Suárez up the middle to drive in Teoscar Hernández, who had singled off starter Tyler Mahle, and pinch-runner Tommy Edman for a 3-1 lead. Didier Fuentes had walked pinch-hitter Josue De Paula and Kyle Tucker to load the bases, with Edman running for De Paula.
Max Muncy’s solo homer off Raisel Iglesias in the ninth padded the lead and gave the slugger 19 postseason home runs with the Dodgers, extending his franchise record.

Dodgers right-hander Tyler Glasnow, making his first start since 24 September, allowed just one hit but walked five batters in four and two-thirds innings. After he issued two walks in the fifth, left-hander Alex Vesia ended the inning by inducing a groundout to second base from Matt Olson.

highlights.title: BMW’s iX4 SUV is a 428-mile defensive weapon against China’s EV takeover
highlights.summary: While much of the automotive world sits dumbfounded as China gobbles up all its customers, BMW continues to roll out extremely well-crafted, technologically advanced electric vehicles that impress in both drive quality and price.
body: The iX4 is a sportier spin on the iX3, with the same powerful Gen6 battery providing class-leading range.

The iX4 is the third vehicle to be released on BMW’s next-generation Neue Klasse platform, following the iX3 and i3 models. The iX4 50 xDrive will come first in March 2027, followed by an even more high-performance M60 xDrive version later in the year. The automaker is positioning this new lineup as its bulwark against the flood of Chinese imports that is currently decimating other European brands. But while the iX4 can certainly compete on range and tech, it’s unclear whether BMW can rival China in terms of sheer affordability.

In that respect, the BMW iX4 50 xDrive starts at $66,200 (excluding fees for destination and handling). And it bears all the hallmarks of BMW’s other Neue Klasse models, such as the “Gen6” high-voltage battery with 112.2kWh of usable energy, an 800-volt architecture for lightning-quick charging top-ups, and up to 428 miles of range based on EPA estimates.

body: ChatGPT’s new College Planner tool will help users keep track of application and financial aid deadlines.

“College Planner brings together application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps for schools on a student’s list in one plan,” OpenAI says. “Students applying to several colleges can return to it to update their progress, use the timeline to plan ahead and see what’s left to do. They can also ask ChatGPT questions along the way, from what a requirement means to how to get started.”

The new College Planner feature will arrive “soon,” according to OpenAI. In the US, ChatGPT will first focus on students in grades 10 through 12 planning to go to a four-year college, the company says.

OpenAI is also updating ChatGPT with new features to help with studying. Users on iOS can now use a continuous, multi-photo capture to upload a bunch of photos at once and then turn them into one PDF. ChatGPT will also be able to make flashcards that can be generated from a user’s notes.

highlights.title: Controversial Horror Series Ropes Me Back In With Silent Hill’s Original Composer And Lady Dimitrescu
highlights.summary: The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired. As a lover of developer Stormind Games' antique perversions, but also a hater of its convoluted storytelling, I regretfully exist somewhere in between.
body: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy latest trailer, which premiered today during the latest Horror Game Awards showcase, revels in the weathered stone buildings and marble fountain angels of the game's Sicilian setting. Stormind Games' developers are based in Sicily themselves, so recreating the decaying decadence of the island for Red Nun's Legacy was like trying to catch a dream right upon waking: You may never remember every detail, but you know the smells and feelings perfectly, because you lived through them.

A statement to press explains, "The Sicily that Stormind Games recreated in Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is the Sicily the team has always lived, seen, breathed. This trailer is a visual journey through the real places, textures, colors, and cultural details that shaped the world of Red Nun's Legacy, stemming directly from the memories of those who developed it."

It looks as gorgeous and imposing as a ballet school built by Dario Argento. But so did the original 2018 Remothered game Tormented Fathers and its 2020 sequel Broken Porcelain, and I don't love them as much as I wanted to.
points: The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired.
